summary: The st daemon serves each tile it supervises a restricted endpoint: the kernel names the calling tile, and the tile may only learn who it is, send as its own agent and read its own mail.

replay.detail: Messages a tile sends are ordinary message claims from its agent; no claim kind or replay change.

schema.detail: No database or graph schema change.

compatibility.detail: Opt-in: without a root-owned /etc/st-tiles/tiles.toml naming this daemon's user as a supervisor, the daemon serves no tile endpoint. The main API socket is unchanged.

downtime.detail: No restart or migration; the daemon follows the registry as it changes.

manual.detail: Nothing to do on upgrade. The root-only proofs (ST_TILES_ROOT_TEST=1 tiles_root) are not run in CI; they were run on a root host for this change.

recovery.detail: Removing a tile or its supervisor_uid from the registry stops its endpoint and closes its open connections.
